dedupe_keys.name: thermal energy storage 1d a 1d finite volume model of a stratified thermal energy storage tank

description: Jonas Pfeiffer at the University of Applied Sciences Zittau/Görlitz publishes a one-dimensional finite-volume model of stratified hot-water storage. It is designed for coupling with district-heating network simulations and supports explicit or implicit time integration, upwind or TVD advection, convective adjustment, and configurable hydraulic and heat-exchanger ports. The June 2026 version 1.0.0 archive is free under GPL-3.0-or-later and links its GitHub source. The provider names validation against the Dronninglund and Høje Taastrup pit-storage sites, but those comparisons were not independently assessed. Coverage and time resolution depend on the tank and numerical settings; programming language and runtime requirements remain unknown from the Zenodo description. The model can support storage sizing and transient thermal simulations. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
